segment.source: Renders one slim band with a back arrow and the title of the page above this one, nothing else. Use it for: the top of a detail page inside a long list, the confirmation page after a form, a deep page whose menu is hidden on small screens, a printed-view page that needs a way home. Prefer 'Path Band' when the reader needs the full trail rather than a single step, and 'Previous and Next' for movement between siblings.
